list.name: Changes
list.comment:
Migrate to @open-webapp/drive-sync, restore per-project subfolders (Phase 5) Update user
Replaces the forked src/lib/driveApi.ts (266 lines) and src/lib/ googleAuth.ts (178 lines) with the published @open-webapp/drive-sync@^0.1.0 library. src/lib/drive.ts holds the app-wide singleton (folderPath ['Notes Diary'], pinned by a test against the library's own driveFake) plus ensureJsonExtension (no library equivalent).
The library's frozen createDriveSync() factory takes one fixed folderPath per instance with no per-project argument, which would have flattened every project's backups into a single shared top-level folder — a real regression from the pre-migration behavior of nesting each project under its own named subfolder (except the legacy single-project app, which used the top-level folder directly). Restored via ensureProjectFolderId(): a second, short-lived createDriveSync() instance per resolution call with a project-scoped folderPath. This is safe because storage.ts's IndexedDB naming only keys off (appId, projectId), never folderPath, so multiple factory instances for the same project share one underlying token/ connection store; only the app-wide `drive` singleton is ever .activate()'d.
Also: re-consent banner for accounts with a drive.file-only grant (detected locally via getConnection().needsReauth, no network call), drive.dropProject wired into deleteProject, and the legacy oauth-token IndexedDB key removed from existing meta stores on boot (notes-diary-{id} DB names unchanged).
Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
